adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: With sensitivity and specificity explicitly fixed, increasing prevalence increases the proportion of positive tests that are true positives and decreases the proportion of negative tests that are true negatives; therefore PPV rises and NPV falls.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: The opposite PPV/NPV direction contradicts Bayes-based predictive-value formulas. Sensitivity and specificity cannot be selected as changing because the stem explicitly holds them unchanged; predictive values do depend on prevalence.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: Spectrum effects can alter sensitivity or specificity in real populations, but the hypothetical explicitly fixes them, so that real-world caveat cannot create a second answer.
